_comment: Live Orbital deployments. Asset INDEX ORDER DIFFERS PER CHAIN (the hook sorts by address; addresses are unrelated across chains) - resolve by symbol, never index, and decode event asset indices via that chain's index order. Realistic decimal mix (USDC/USDT 6dp, DAI/FRAX 18dp). CONCENTRATED LIQUIDITY: a tick's reserves below its band's floor (xMin) are virtual and never deposited; `reserves(i)` is the engine's virtual reserve, tokens held are `reserves(i) - virtualReserve()`. Seeded with script/lib/TierLadder.sol in REAL capital: 6M per asset (~$24M TVL per pool); stable profile 25% each at 0.9995 / 0.998 / 0.99 bands + full range. Settlement is by authenticated Hyperlane message. REDEPLOYED 2026-09-13 with virtual liquidity, the safeguarded Newton solver and the last-interior-tick guard. The Arc FX pool (5042002.fx) shares the Arc stable pool's USDC and USDT.

_arc.gasTokenNote: Native USDC is 18dp; the ERC-20 view of the same asset is 6dp. Never mix raw values. Faucet: https://faucet.circle.com
_arc.poolManagerNote: SELF-DEPLOYED. Uniswap has no v4 deployment on Arc testnet (verified 2026-09-06: every canonical PoolManager address returns 0 bytes, and Arc is absent from the official v4 deployments list). Arc MAINNET (5042) does have one at 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951.
_arc.mailboxNote: NOT HYPERLANE. TestnetMailbox shim, see script/mocks/TestnetMailbox.sol. Hyperlane has no Arc testnet entry; the registry carries Arc MAINNET only (domain 5042, mailbox 0x7f50C5776722630a0024fAE05fDe8b47571D7B39). Messages dispatched here are events only and are NEVER relayed, which is why `peers` is empty and Arc is not part of the live 3-chain mesh. The settler's inbound auth checks are real and unmodified; only transport is stubbed.
_arc.mainnetPath: Arc mainnet opens 2026-09-16 with both canonical v4 and canonical Hyperlane. Re-run script/DeployArc.s.sol with V4_POOL_MANAGER and HYPERLANE_MAILBOX set to get real cross-chain with no code changes.

_feed.note: Chainlink has no Arc testnet feeds. This mirror copies each round of Chainlink EUR / USD on Ethereum mainnet (script/mocks/TestnetFxFeed.sol, synced by script/fx/SyncFxFeed.s.sol). Arc mainnet (5042) has Chainlink EUR / USD at 0xDd5B15443cd733D3966a50a3E48cB7DF9Fb5DE0D, the DeployArcFX default there.
_feed.maxPriceAgeNote: 30h = Chainlink 24h FX heartbeat + relay lag for the mirror hop. A direct Chainlink feed uses 25h.

fx._tokens: USDC and USDT are the Arc stable pool's own contracts (shared, one USDC per chain); EURC and EURe are unique to this pool.
fx._ladder: TierLadder FX profile: 25% of capital each at 0.995 / 0.99 / 0.97 bands + full range.
